title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?

lines.text: Rusty fell into a black hole.
Its gravity pulls on his feet much harder than on his head,
so he gets stretched out like a noodle.
His friend, watching from far away, sees something strange.
turns red, and fades away, frozen at the edge.
But for Rusty, or what's left of him, time runs normally.
He crosses the event horizon, where not even light can escape.
